dogecoin.text: It's really funny to see people get mad at the unemployed and spout shit like "If you were smart like me you would have invested in dogecoin."

@Shoeknight1 I keep on thinking about how the guy behind Dogecoin turned his back on Crypto because he realized it had become an even worse version of how the Stock Market works. All a bunch of schemes to gain money without providing any tangible goods or services.
